intro: Ten minutes before curtain, every part in the pit was swapped for something else. The baton lies untouched on the stand, and the podium is empty. The orchestra is not angry; they are sorting. Cellists compare bowings with the horn section, percussionists hold up parts to the light as if checking watermarks. First violins have found two copies of the same page, side by side, one wearing a sticky note with a time written on it. The rehearsal pianist keeps finding mismatched pages lying exactly where she left them, as though someone is tidying around her. Nobody will say it out loud, but the copyist’s room on the third floor is still lit.
echo: The one person on stage who makes no sound at all.
